errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the vegetable 'Главесто зеле' (Cabbage) as 'тиквосто зеле'. 'Тиква' means pumpkin.
The description incorrectly identifies the vegetable 'Лук кромид - зрял' (Onions - mature) as 'лук кромид - зелен' (Onions - green).
The description states that the yield for potatoes in 2022 was 'a little over 180,000 tons', but the blue bar is visibly below the 180,000 line, at approximately 172,000 tons.

errors.text_span: а най-ниската е при краставиците и корнишоните за 2023 година
errors.evidence: The description identifies the lowest value as being for 'краставици и корнишони' in 2023. While this is one of the lowest values, the absolute lowest bar on the chart is for the same category but in 2022 (the blue bar).

errors.text_span: за картофите около 180 000 тона през 2022 г.
errors.evidence: The description gives a representative value for potatoes in 2022 as 'around 180,000 tons'. The actual value shown by the bar is significantly lower, at approximately 172,000 tons.
The description uses the word 'домина', which is a misspelling of 'домати' (tomatoes), the actual category name on the chart.
